formattedAddress: 106, Taiwan, Taipei City, Da’an District, Guangwu Village, Lane 190, Section 1, Dunhua S Rd, 43號1樓

text.text: Unassuming little store recommended by our foodie cousin so we knew it would be amazing! It did not disappoint! Everything we had was so delicious! My favorite was the shrimp and asparagus hand roll. I’ve had many of these in my life but this was the best one by far with the crunchy texture inside. The crab/ikura/potato salad shell is a must order as well. The uni hand roll was sweet and not fishy. We were in love with the pork katsu Sando as well. The pork was super juicy and thick. I could barely bite it. I like that they offered katsu sauce or salt and pepper to season. It gave different flavors to the one dish. It’s enough for 2 to share and be quite satisfied. We will definitely be coming back!

text.text:
Came here via verbal recommendation from my cousin and this place exceeded my expectations in every way.

The food was just superb, we ordered the uni and the shrimp and asparagus hand rolls (both were excellent, especially the shrimp and asparagus), the katsu sando, mentaiko and their featured crab sando, and they all exceeded expectations in the best way possible.

Reservation strongly recommended as we saw many walk-in parties get turned away due to the small size of the restaurant. This place is an absolute must try!!

text.text:
Not your authentic Japanese restaurant, more of a Taiwanese/Japanese/American fusion place. That said, the dishes were all delicious albeit in a non traditional sense?

My sushi roll had mashed potatoes and drizzled with lots of sauces… definitely more North American than Japanese. The saving grace was definitely the tempura shrimps, tasted fresh and delicious.

The soy sauce on the table was too sweet for me to go with the sashimi, and so was the salmon roe. It tasted much sweeter than those I’ve had before, which made me question whether they were real or artificially made.

Overall, I appreciate the service. Staffs were kind and helpful in answering all our questions, but I’m not sure if I’d return… I guess if I’m in the mood for fusion Japanese food?

p.s. they offer a free mentaiko potato for those leaving 5 star reviews… a gimmick I whole disagree but oh well

text.text: The servers are friendly and attentive. The food is delicate, fresh, and thoughtfully prepared — not too salty or oily. Each dish highlights the natural flavors of the ingredients. A calm and refined dining experience overall.
